versions.changelog:
cruise-trip 3.2.1

- Updated documentation for improved clarity in README.md and SKILL.md.
- Refined references and playbook instructions for enhanced usability.
- No CLI logic or parameter changes; workflow and usage remain the same.
- Minor formatting corrections and instructional enhancements in reference files.

cruise-trip 3.2.0 changelog:

- Expanded skill scope: now supports train tickets, attraction tickets, itinerary planning, visa info, travel insurance, car rental, and more (previously focused on cruises/flights/hotels).
- All feature searches are powered by Fliggy (Alibaba Group) via the flyai CLI for real-time results and booking links.
- Updated compatibility list for broader agent support.
- Enforced critical execution rules: never answer without CLI data, always provide [Book](...) links, and support strict language following (Chinese/English).
- Added comprehensive workflow and playbooks; clearer parameter mapping and enrichment guidance.
